scope: Compact plane/quadratic proposal admission on every fixed verified disk domain; no reference replacement
domain_selection: All 405 unchanged atlas domains, every acquired face once, no fit-dependent crop or merging
fit: Unchanged frozen plane/quadratic fitter, source-ID modulo-five holdout, training-only frame/scale and full-source triangle-area vertex weights
short_support: Keep as exact native acquired-facet reference; do not fit or reduce support limits
projection: Each newly fitted training frame needs complete original shared-simplex contact admission; inherited parent-frame admission is not transferred
boundary_checks: For every fitted proposal, compute full quadratic-curve source-boundary correspondence bounds. Separately diagnose every cut and original shared-vertex inter-domain contact for two fixed plane/quadratic families; unfitted neighbors use exact original source geometry. Rejected fits remain diagnostic, never adopted.
bound_method: Producer power-basis quadratic vector curves converted to Bernstein; independent verifier obtains coefficients from endpoint/midpoint positions. Maximum control-vector norm bounds all edge parameters. Explicit sample norms are lower witnesses.
acceptance: A domain needs complete-triangle digital bound, new-frame projection admission and source-boundary continuity before native export eligibility; shared-chart continuity remains an additional assembly requirement. No native export or geometry adoption occurs in this trial.
inference_limits: Within-scan transductive digital tests, not physical tolerance/metrology or general model evaluation. Source observations and existing exact native references remain unchanged.
